notes: Each skill is installed once, under roots[<root>].

harnessRoots[] inventories every skill root on this machine: role=install roots hold the canonical copy, role=mirror roots are junctions, role=harness roots belong to another agent and role=managed roots ship inside an app.
mirrors[] lists Windows directory junctions that expose those folders under other agents' skill directories; create them, never copy.
drift[] lists same-named copies whose SKILL.md hash differs from the canonical install; link=true means a junction into another root, link=false means a separate copy, so compare before trusting one.

source.type=repo installs from this repository (skills/original or the approved bundled copies in skills/third-party), source.type=github uses git sparse-checkout, source.type=unresolved has no identified upstream and must be copied by hand.

authorship=original only for the owner's own skills (installed from skills/original/); bundled third-party skills stay third-party even though they install from this repository, and unknown skills are never promoted into skills/original/ and keep their upstream author.
node_modules is never copied; run npm install in skills with needsNodeModules=true.
cindyManagedSkills and codexManagedSkills ship inside their app and are never copied between machines.
